'''Tauade''' is a [[Papuan language]] of [[Kira Rural LLG]] in [[Central Province (Papua New Guinea)|Central Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].

== External links ==
* [[Paradisec]] has the Tom Dutton collection ([https://catalog.paradisec.org.au/collections/TD1 TD1]) that includes Tauade language materials.
